intro: Danes regularly rank among the happiest people in the world, and they have a word for cosy togetherness: hygge.

chapters.title: Danish life
text: Copenhagen is the capital and by far the largest city. Danes trust each other and their government, pay high taxes for free education and healthcare, and cycle a lot: about half of Copenhagen's commuters travel by bike.
Hygge means a warm, cosy feeling, often with candles, food and friends. Danish flags appear on birthday cakes and in windows on birthdays.

chapters.title: Faith and language
text: Danish is the national language. Most Danes belong to the Lutheran Church of Denmark, the state church, though few attend regularly.

keyTerms.meaning: A Danish word for a cosy, contented feeling.
